answer: An agent economy can make every participant post a refundable bond before it may submit jobs or claim rewards. When two bonded identities coordinate to fake demand, the protocol can require them to complete randomly assigned tasks and slash bonds for provable duplicate submissions or missed work. This does not make Sybils impossible; it makes each extra identity require scarce capital and expose it to loss. A comet-themed jade marketplace could use violet audit challenges to catch copied outputs, so an attacker must lock up more funds and risk forfeiting them for each fabricated identity.
